business_problem: Crédit Agricole Consumer Finance wanted a reusable AI environment that business teams could use to deploy machine learning models for higher-value client targeting, beginning with a use case to optimize LifeTime Value for new clients and recommend the best next offer to sales representatives.
solution_summary: Crédit Agricole Consumer Finance built CEOS as an internal data science platform for deploying machine learning models into business workflows. The article says the platform is hosted on the AWS cloud and runs on an open-source Kubernetes foundation, giving the bank a managed environment that can orchestrate deployed applications securely and scale resources up or down automatically with demand. Business data enters the platform from client files, where models learn from customer characteristics to estimate lifetime value and determine the next best offer that representatives can present. Operationally, Digital Services France leads the initiative using an MLOps approach, the Architecture and Innovation team provides business tools and industrialization processes for AI models, the Data Tools team defines the development framework and onboarding path, and CA GIP supplies and maintains the technical base. The same platform is positioned for reuse across lending, fraud, risk, and compliance functions.
